title: Core: FLA round-trip preserves frame scripts
description: Test that a FlashDocument with AS2 frame scripts round-trips through saveFla/loadFla without data loss. Build a doc with frames that have non-empty script fields. Verify: (1) script content survives saveFla+loadFla, (2) scripts on different layers/frames are all preserved, (3) special characters in scripts (quotes, backslashes, unicode) survive, (4) empty string scripts remain empty.
